title: Extensions feature removed — file documents nonexistent feature
reality: v2.3.4 removed the extension feature completely: all extension CSS, browser, and server payload execution is gone; the Settings surface, client hooks, the shared marinara JS contract, and the /api/extensions routes were deleted; startup permanently erases every retained server record and extension-storage:* setting; the UI-state migration removes browser-local extension records; authoring guides, examples, and Professor Mari's extension instructions were removed. Verified upstream: docs/extending/ now contains only custom-tools.md and regex-scripts.md.
fix: Rewrite extensions.md as a tombstone: retitle to 'Client Extensions (REMOVED in v2.3.4)', open with a prominent removal notice, keep a brief historical summary of what the feature was, and add a migration section. Strip or collapse all present-tense feature documentation.

title: marinara API reference and code examples document deleted contract
reality: The entire marinara API surface (extensionId, addStyle, addElement, apiFetch, on, observe, setInterval/setTimeout, onCleanup, marinara.storage) and every code example in the file target a contract deleted in v2.3.4. marinara.storage data (extension-storage:* app settings) and all server extension records are PERMANENTLY erased on first 2.3.4 startup — no export or recovery path.
fix: Delete the API reference sections and all CSS/JS/apiFetch examples. Replace with a short note that the marinara contract no longer exists and an explicit data warning: extension config stored via marinara.storage was wiped at 2.3.4 startup and cannot be recovered — users need a pre-2.3.4 backup.

title: Installation section points at deleted Settings surface and routes
reality: Settings → Addons → Extensions no longer exists; the /api/extensions CRUD routes and the zip import/export envelope (extension-transfer.ts) were deleted. Settings > Addons still exists but hosts installed THEMES only.
fix: Replace 'Installation and Distribution' with a removal note: the Addons tab remains but lists themes only; /api/extensions and the marinara-extensions.json zip format are gone. Keep the warning that Download Agents never distributed extensions, reframed in past tense.

title: Professor Mari extension-building claim now false
reality: v2.3.4 removed Professor Mari's extension instructions along with the feature. Her workspace agent can no longer create or edit browser extensions; themes, agents, and custom tools remain (the installed_extensions table her mari db CLI touched is part of the removed surface).
fix: Drop extensions from the 'Professor Mari can build extensions and themes' paragraph; note her extension instructions were removed in 2.3.4.

title: 'UI to do X → extension' routing dead-ends; replacements exist
reality: The routing sections recommend a removed surface. v2.3.4 sanctioned paths: native Appearance settings + server-synced custom themes for styling; downloadable agent capability packages for server runtimes/commands/client surfaces; and NEW in 2.3.4, disabled-by-default custom GitHub AGENT repositories in Agents Manager (#3861) — now the sanctioned third-party distribution path. Forking covers everything else.
fix: Replace the decision routing and 'When to Use' table: styling → Settings → Appearance / custom themes; capability additions → downloadable agent packages via the official catalog or custom GitHub agent repositories (#3861); arbitrary client JS → no supported path, fork the engine. This migration table is the core of the tombstone rewrite.

title: Imported agents can no longer bundle custom functions or self-grant tools
reality: v2.3.4 (#3953): imported agent files are prevented from installing bundled custom functions, granting themselves tool access, or overwriting a curated Agent by reusing its internal type. Agent exports no longer bundle function definitions; imported agents receive a fresh custom identity requiring the user to review and explicitly attach tools afterward.
fix: Add a 'Tool portability (v2.3.4, #3953)' note under 'UI Location'/attachment: exported agents do NOT bundle custom function definitions; recipients must recreate/attach tools explicitly after import; imported agents cannot self-grant tool access or impersonate curated agent types.

title: Connection parameters note misses #3845 Noodle defaults and new custom-endpoint params
reality: v2.3.4 (#3845) extends the 'Connection Custom Parameters (v2.3)' note: enabled Connection generation defaults now apply across EVERY Noodle text-generation path, and custom OpenAI-compatible endpoints accept explicitly enabled top-k, reasoning-effort, and verbosity parameters.
fix: Append the (v2.3.4, #3845) sentence to the Connection Custom Parameters paragraph.

title: Regex Scripts framing still offers UI extensions as an alternative
reality: The Regex Scripts section says reach for regex when the request is 'not a custom tool, and not a UI extension' — UI extensions were removed in v2.3.4.
fix: Reword to drop the extension mention (or note extensions no longer exist as an alternative since 2.3.4).

title: Conditional macro operators and {{group}} macro undocumented
reality: v2.3.4 added || (OR), && (AND), parentheses, and equality-list shorthand to conditional prompt macros, plus a new {{group}} macro listing every other active chat character (working even during targeted Roleplay group generation, where the full roster is kept available).
fix: Add to the skill's macro documentation (architecture.md Macros list and/or character-cards.md macros section — custom-tools.md has no macro section to host it).

title: ComfyUI local video generation and official workflow guide missing
reality: v2.3.4 added local ComfyUI video generation for API-format WAN and other workflows with prompt, size, seed, frame-count, and uploaded first-frame placeholders (#3804), plus an in-app and GitHub ComfyUI workflow guide (#3749) — verified live at docs/media/comfyui.md upstream. The skill lists ComfyUI for image gen only.
fix: In the providers/video-generation coverage (architecture.md), add ComfyUI local video generation with Marinara placeholders (#3804) and cite docs/media/comfyui.md as the workflow guide (#3749).

title: PocketTTS server voices now directly selectable
reality: v2.3.4 (#3786): PocketTTS server voices are directly selectable for global, character, and narrator assignments, custom voice IDs/URLs/paths are retained, and new setups align with the compatible server's default endpoint.

title: TTS dialogue pause changed to whole seconds 1-60
reality: v2.3.4 changed the TTS dialogue pause control (added 2.3.3, #3718) to whole seconds from 1 through 60, migrating legacy sub-second and no-pause values to the new 1-second minimum. Any 2.3.3-era pause note elsewhere in the skill is now stale.
fix: Wherever the skill documents the 2.3.3 configurable TTS dialogue pauses (#3718), update to the whole-second range.

title: NovelAI prompt review shows subject-count-resolved dimensions
reality: v2.3.4 (#3758): image prompt review now displays the subject-count-resolved dimensions actually sent to native NovelAI, Prompt Prefix count tokens are kept out of scene sizing, and new NovelAI settings are backfilled for legacy partial profiles.
fix: Extend the NovelAI provider note (architecture.md) with #3758.
